Looping in for deal context. Sam/Priya — quick note on timing from our side: if Acme is likely to be in a spend freeze through Apr 15, it often makes sense to (A) do a short discovery/demo now to build internal consensus and (B) put a tentative hold for a procurement slot post-FY reset so your budget team has an anchor.

- If procurement is locked until mid-April, we'll mark the deal for an early-April follow-up meeting focused solely on pricing/PO next steps. I can own the internal renewal/ops checklist so approvals are faster when the window opens.
